subject: SIG questionnaire: scoping, control crosswalk and evidence handoff for AstraNova
messages:
From: Julie Martin <julie.martin@astranova.com>
To: maya.srinivasan@redwood.com
Cc: procure@astranova.com, eli.thompson@astranova.com
Date: Fri, 2 Mar 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: AstraNova SIG questionnaire v2 - initial scoping

Maya —

Thanks again for taking our call yesterday. Attached is AstraNova's updated SIG questionnaire (v2) with a few additional control clarification rows we added after an internal review. Our security team highlighted three things we need to confirm before we proceed to the procurement window:

1) Is there an auditable key-management flow we can map to the SIG "KMS custody" controls? If so, can you provide a sample artifact showing key rotation logs or certificates?

2) For user provisioning (SCIM / SSO), we need an exact mapping of the SIG control IDs to your implementation and a note on whether you accept delegated admin access from our IdP for provisioning pipelines.

3) Data residency and retention: please confirm which regions you guarantee for encrypted storage and the retention window for telemetry logs used for observability.

We're on a tight timeline — procurement intends to close by 3/10. If possible, could you return a control crosswalk and an evidence list by Tuesday EOD?

Attachments: astranova-sig-questionnaire-v2.xlsx

Thanks,
Julie Martin
Sr. InfoSec Program Manager
AstraNova Financial

From: maya.srinivasan@redwood.com
To: Julie Martin <julie.martin@astranova.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, kimberly_park@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 2 Mar 2028 11:38:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: AstraNova SIG questionnaire v2 - initial scoping

Julie —

Appreciate the clear asks and the timeline. Quick summary of our plan to deliver what you requested by Tuesday EOD:

- Control crosswalk: we will map the SIG control IDs to our implemented controls and reference the specific artifacts (e.g., key rotation logs, SCIM provisioning audit) in an Excel crosswalk.
- KMS proof: Kimberly will attach a sample KMS proof bundle showing rotation events, access policy snips, and a redacted audit entry. The bundle is a representative sample (not tenant-specific) but should satisfy technical reviewers.
- SCIM/SSO: Karthik will confirm delegated provisioning options and provide a short note on admin relationships and how we enforce least privilege.
- Data residency/retention: I'll include our supported region list and the telemetry retention window.

We may have one or two clarifying questions while we map controls (e.g., specific SIG control row numbering in your sheet). Could you flag any rows that are highest priority for legal/compliance review?

We will deliver: 1) control crosswalk (Excel), 2) evidence manifest (list + attachments), 3) short technical memo for KMS and SCIM.

Regards,
Maya Srinivasan
Director, Assurance Programs
Redwood Inference

Attachment: redwood-sig-crosswalk-20280302.xlsx (will be delivered with follow-up)

From: kimberly_park@redwood.com
To: Julie Martin <julie.martin@astranova.com>, maya.srinivasan@redwood.com
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 5 Mar 2028 08:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: KMS evidence and SCIM notes for AstraNova (draft)

Julie / Maya —

Forwarding our draft evidence pack for KMS and provisioning. Please see inline notes below and the attached representative PDFs.

--- Forwarded message ---
From: kimberly_park@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 5 Mar 2028 08:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Draft: KMS proof bundle and SCIM provisioning audit snippet
To: maya.srinivasan@redwood.com

Attached: kms-proof-sample.pdf — contains:
- Redacted rotation events (timestamps, key IDs)
- KMS access policy snippet (roles, conditions)
- System-generated audit entry showing rotation performed by automation (no user PII)

SCIM provisioning notes (in-line):
- We support SCIM 2.0; Azure AD and Okta are validated connector partners.
- You can delegate a provisioning admin role scoped to a single app via SAML assertions; full tenant-level delegated admin is not supported.
- All SCIM provisioning events are logged and stored in our observability events table for 90 days; a jailed, immutable audit stream persists for 365 days for legal hold requests.

Data residency / retention summary:
- Encrypted object storage: US-West (Oregon), US-East (N. Virginia), EU-West (Frankfurt). Customer can request region pinning for storage and KV caches at provisioning time for Dedicated/Private customers.
- Telemetry: default 90 days; can be increased to 365 days for enterprise contracts with retention pricing.

Questions for AstraNova:
1) For the KMS artifact, do you need HSM attestation or will encrypted rotation logs from our KMS suffice?
2) Which SIG rows correspond to delegated admin/provisioning — we mapped likely candidates but want confirmation.

Regards,
Kimberly Park
Security & Compliance Lead, Redwood Inference

Attachments: kms-proof-sample.pdf

From: Julie Martin <julie.martin@astranova.com>
To: maya.srinivasan@redwood.com, kimberly_park@redwood.com
Cc: procure@astranova.com, eli.thompson@astranova.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 3 Mar 2028 15:48:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: AstraNova SIG questionnaire v2 - initial scoping

Thanks, Maya and Kimberly — that looks great and answers most of the reviewer's questions. A couple quick items before we close the procurement review: 

- For the KMS artifact, our team prefers an HSM attestation for any key custodial controls tied to customer-sensitive encryption. Can you indicate whether you offer an HSM-backed configuration for Dedicated/Private customers and, if so, who issues the attestation?

- SCIM: Confirmed the SIG rows we care about are 4.2, 4.3 and 7.1 in our workbook (see attached highlighted sheet). If you can mark those rows in the crosswalk, that will speed internal approvals.

If you can get those two items to us by EOD Monday, we'll move forward with a contract signature window next week.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Best,
Julie

Attachment: astranova-sig-questionnaire-v2_highlighted_rows.xlsx
